name: Burrito Sonora Loaded with Cheese & Refried Beans
whyItWorks: Stuffed with whole lard-cooked pinto beans, melted jack cheese, sour cream, and spiced salsa, this hefty burrito delivers high fermentable oligosaccharides (GOS) that trigger severe gas, distention, and diarrhea in IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fiber & Gas Warning: Avoid bean-heavy burritos. Switch to grilled chicken tacos on corn tortillas.
